Pre-lock, only aggregate ownership data is available, enabling a probabilistic estimate of field composition. At lock, the system transitions to deterministic enumeration of up to 20,000 individual lineups. This requires careful handling of pagination and rate limiting to avoid hitting 429 errors. The process is modeled as a temporal dynamical system with three distinct regimes: pre-lock (statistical inference), at-lock (data retrieval), and post-lock (complete consensus). Each regime has different information-theoretic properties and computational complexity. The failure mode arises from insufficient session management or incorrect pagination parameters, leading to partial or failed data pulls.
